1.	Preparation: Establishing plans, policies, and trained teams.
2.	Detection & Analysis: Identifying anomalies using SIEM and confirming the incident.
3.	Containment: Isolating systems to stop the spread (e.g., updating firewall rules).
4.	Eradication: Removing the root cause, such as wiping infected drives or patching vulnerabilities.

Sawirrada labadan waxay muujinayaan in dhibaatadu aysan ka imaan diiwaanada DNS-ka ee hoosaadyada (sub-domains), maadaama ay dhammaantood si sax ah loo dhisay oo ay yihiin 10 diiwaan oo shaqeynaya. Dhibaatadu waxay ka timaadaa heerka guud ee domain-ka (root domain: iecms.gov.so), kaas oo akoonka Cloudflare uu ku calaamadiyay xaalad "Moved", iyo maqnaanshaha diiwaan A/CNAME oo loogu talagalay www iyo bogga hoyga (root). Taasi waxay u baahan tahay in la xaqiijiyo xaaladda diiwaangelinta domain-ka ee heer qaran (.SO) ama in la dib-u-dejiyo (reconfigure) diiwaanka root-ka iyo www si loo soo celiyo gelitaanka goobta.
